selected_candidate.title: How to Find Saved Text in ClipNest | iPhone Screenshot Guide
selected_candidate.description:
To find saved text in ClipNest, open search in the main app and enter a word you remember. The example shows a search for Project and the matching Project brief clip.

Still-screen guide using real iPhone simulator screenshots with original demonstration text. No typing, clipboard capture, paste action, save result, or speed demonstration is shown.

Explore ClipNest for iPhone and iPad:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/clipnest-clipboard-history/id6779928552

#ClipNest #ClipboardHistory #Shorts
